metadata.title: Email Data Protection Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the architectural pattern for protecting sensitive data within institutional email services, including prevention of unauthorized disclosure, encryption, justification, and auditability. This pattern is vendor-agnostic and expresses security intent only.

components.title: Email Data Protection
components.description: Protects sensitive and regulated data handled by institutional email services through policy-based controls such as data loss prevention, encryption, justification, and auditable access.

links.text: Data Reference Model - Regulated / Sensitive Information

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email services must enforce cryptographic protection for sensitive data where required.
Email services must protect the integrity of information and prevent unauthorized disclosure.
Email data protection decisions must be auditable, including enforcement actions and overrides.
Access to sensitive activity or usage metadata via email must be justified, authorized, and auditable, implementing obligations derived from applicable legislation.

components.remarks: This pattern defines architectural requirements for protecting data in email systems. Product-specific DLP features, encryption mechanisms, baselines (e.g., CIS or STIG), and lifecycle governance are addressed in realization artifacts.
